senses.gloss:
रोचक रोचक, i. e. रुच् + अक,
 1. adj. What pleases, brightens.
 II. m.
 1. Hunger.
 2. A stomachic.
 3. A sort of onion.
 4. Plantain.
 --Comp.

रोचन रोचन, i. e. रुच् + अन,
 I. adj.
 1. Irradiating.
 2. Splendid.
 3. Pleasing.
 4. Sharpening (the appetite).
 II. m.
 1. A stomachic.
 2. The name of several plants.
 III. f. ना and नी, A yellow pigment, supposed to be the concrete bile of the cow, or to be found in the head of the animal, Man. 8, 234.
 IV. f. ना, An excellent woman.
 V. f. नी, Red arsenic, Pāṇ. iv. 2, 2.
 VI. n. The æther, Chr. 288, 1 = Rigv. i. 49, 1.
 --Comp.
रोचिष्णु रोचिष्णु, i. e. रुच् + इष्णु, adj. Elegantly dressed, Pāṇ. iii. 2, 136.

रोचिस् रोचिस्, i. e. रुच् + इस्, n. Light, flame.
 --Comp.
